title_en: Notice of Class Cancellations and Building Access Restrictions for the College of Engineering Early Admission (수시모집) Interviews for the 2027 Academic Year
summary: Because of the interviews (and oral examinations) for the 2027 early admission (수시모집) rounds, certain classes will be cancelled and Building 302 and Building 39 will be closed to general access on the dates and times stated below. Make-up classes must be held for all cancelled classes.
applies_to: For the General Admission interviews: all courses offered by the College of Engineering, and anyone needing access to Building 302. For the Regional Balance Selection and Opportunity Balance Selection Special Admission interviews: courses taught by interview committee members, all courses held in Building 39, and anyone needing access to Building 39. Examination personnel are exempt from the access restrictions; department, division and major offices operate normally.

steps: Note that all courses offered by the College of Engineering are cancelled from Thursday, 26 November 2026, 09:00 to Friday, 27 November 2026, 20:00; make-up classes must be held.
Do not enter Building 302 (the entire building) during this period; access is possible again after 8:00 p.m. on Friday, 27 November 2026.

Note that courses taught by interview committee members and all courses held in Building 39 are cancelled from Thursday, 3 December 2026, 09:00 to Friday, 4 December 2026, 20:00; make-up classes must be held.
Do not enter Building 39 (the entire building) during this period; access is possible again after 8:00 p.m. on Friday, 4 December 2026.
Do not enter any examination rooms (lecture rooms, professors' offices, seminar rooms, meeting rooms, etc.) in the restricted buildings during these periods unless you are examination personnel.
Cooperate so that the early admission process can proceed smoothly.
translation:
Notice of Class Cancellations and Building Access Restrictions for the College of Engineering Early Admission (수시모집) Interviews for the 2027 Academic Year

Posted: 8 October 2026

In connection with the interviews (and oral examinations) for the 2027 early admission (수시모집) General Admission (일반전형), Regional Balance Admission (지역균형전형) and Opportunity Balance Special Admission (기회균형특별전형), classes will be cancelled and access to buildings will be restricted as set out below. Your active cooperation is requested so that the early admission process can proceed smoothly.

A. Class cancellations and access restrictions

General Admission (일반전형) – Friday, 27 November 2026
- Class cancellation period: Thursday, 26 November 2026, 09:00 to Friday, 27 November, 20:00
- Courses cancelled: all courses offered by the College of Engineering (make-up classes must be held)
- Access restriction: all of Building 302 (302동) (1 building)
※ Building 302 may be entered after 8:00 p.m. on Friday, 27 November.

Regional Balance Selection Admission (지역균형선발전형) and Opportunity Balance Selection Special Admission (기회균형선발특별전형) – Friday, 4 December 2026
- Class cancellation period: Thursday, 3 December 2026, 09:00 to Friday, 4 December, 20:00
- Courses cancelled: courses taught by interview committee members and all courses held in Building 39 (39동) (make-up classes must be held)
- Access restriction: all of Building 39 (39동) (1 building)
※ Building 39 may be entered after 8:00 p.m. on Friday, 4 December.

※ During these periods, no one other than examination personnel may enter the examination rooms (lecture rooms, professors' offices, seminar rooms, meeting rooms, etc.) located in the restricted buildings.
※ Offices (departments/divisions, majors, etc.) will operate normally (staff will be working as usual).

The notice does not list a contact; for questions, please contact the department office.
